Our vision

Quality over quantity.

Kraftlytouch has one clear vision: to make only quality, and to keep working on that quality instead of chasing quantity.

In a world full of plastic, we want to offer an environment-friendly, sustainable choice. Every piece we make is wood from start to finish, built to last for years rather than end up in a landfill.

Made by the manufacturer

We are the manufacturer, not a trader. We use only the finest seasoned and chemically treated wood, so every piece stays strong, stable and long-lasting.

Food safe and waterproof

Every product is sealed with top-grade Italian ICA PU and SABU PU finishes, which makes it completely food safe and waterproof for everyday use.

A sustainable choice

Natural wood in place of plastic. Our kitchenware is renewable, reusable and made to be used and loved for a long time.

Make in India

Designed, cut, turned and finished by skilled artisans in Saharanpur. Our work proudly supports Make in India.

Materials & finish

Honest wood, properly sealed.

We work with four main hardwoods, each seasoned and treated before it reaches the lathe or the saw. Every product is then coated with PU, which makes it water resistant, food grade and easy to wash.

  • AcaciaDense and durable with a rich, varied grain. Our most used wood for boards, platters and bowls.
  • MangoLight, even grain with golden tones. Ideal for trays, bowls and serving pieces.
  • TeakNaturally oily and water resistant. Used for drinkware, mugs and premium trays.
  • SheeshamIndian rosewood with deep brown colour. Chosen for spice boxes, games and décor.

Prefer a natural look? We also offer buff, oil and wax finishes. Pieces in normal finish, instead of PU, are priced lower.

Caring for your wood

  • DoHand wash with a soft scrub and mild soap
  • DoWipe dry and store in a ventilated place
  • AvoidSoaking or leaving submerged in water
  • AvoidMicrowave and dishwasher
  • AvoidDirect flame and very hot surfaces

Wood is natural. Small variations in grain and colour make each piece unique and may differ slightly from the photos.

Customised · Combos · Gifting

Made the way you need it.

Every product in our catalogue can be customised, and we are happy to develop new articles for you. Choose the wood, size, finish and branding, or let us put together a combo set that fits your occasion and budget.

  • Branding and personalisation on request
  • Custom sizes, shapes and finishes on any listed product
  • Curated combo sets and premium gift hampers
  • Corporate, festive, wedding and return gifts
  • Bulk supply for retail stores, hotels and exporters

Customisation is available with a minimum order quantity (MOQ) that depends on the product.

Our craft

From Saharanpur, the wooden city.

Our skilled artisans carefully handcraft each piece in our own factory, warehouse and production units, with every step under one roof.

  1. 2019Started as a wood products dealer in Saharanpur, a city known for its wooden crafts.
  2. 2020Set out to manufacture wooden goods of a higher calibre than the local market offered.
  3. 2021Built our team and began testing food-safe finishes for long-lasting, practical products.
  4. 2022Partnered with quality-focused merchants and came back strong after the Covid years.
  5. 2023Grew a market for teak and food-safe acacia kitchenware, shipped overseas.
  6. 2024Rebuilt after a severe warehouse fire and successfully re-entered the market.
  7. 2025Partnered with leading retail stores through dedicated business tours.
  8. 2026Opened three production units in Saharanpur and a new wooden blocks manufacturing facility.

For businesses

Retail, hotelware and export.

We supply retail stores, hotels, restaurants, cafés and exporters. Send us your SKU list and quantities, and we will reply with a quotation, lead time and packing options.

  • Some catalogue products are available for bulk orders only.
  • Freight and taxes (GST) are charged extra.
  • Special packing is charged in addition.
  • Normal finish (without PU) is available at a lower price.
